snapshot.why_bibliographic: In copyright (Association for Symbolic Logic). The only legitimately hosted copy found is the author-department PDF at https://as.nyu.edu/content/dam/nyu-as/philosophy/documents/faculty-documents/fine/accessible_fine/Fine_Pure-Logic-Ground.pdf. It was read in full for pp. 3-7 on 2026-10-27 (two fetches, identical bytes sha256:33ec1719f306cd03115bf6d10cc5af2e8ae75b18efa7312d11e888f98d2a5970; pdftotext text of physical pages 3-7 sha256:bcb1cbb740aa6aa3ce970efec8fda695276d2cfcaf2b3f8e11f5b4ce3d82b799; its 'Page N of 25' pagination equals the journal's). It cannot serve as a web_snapshot: the host answers GitHub's CI runners with HTTP 405, so `source_evidence.py verify` cannot refetch it, and no Wayback fallback could be pinned because web.archive.org was unreachable from the pinning environment (#348). Upgrade to a web_snapshot with those hashes once a matching Wayback capture is pinned.
